mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Reviews (PRODUCT_IDX, USER_IDX, USER_NAME, REVIEW,RATING, IS_HIDE,REG_DATE) VALUES (#{productIdx}, #{userIdx}, #{userName}, #{review}, #{rating}, #{isHide}, NOW())
INSERT INTO ReviewImage ( review_idx, review_img) VALUES (#{reviewIdx}, #{reviewImg} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.review_Idx AS reviewIdx, r.product_Idx AS productIdx, r.user_Idx AS userIdx, r.user_Name AS userName, r.review AS review, r.Rating AS rating, r.is_Hide AS isHide, r.Reg_Date AS regDate, items.color AS color, items.size AS size FROM Reviews r INNER JOIN OrderItems items ON r.product_Idx = items.product_Idx WHERE r.user_Idx = #{userIdx}
